channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: US-Iran MoU is set to expire: What to know
item.description: Both sides accused the other of violating the June agreement shortly after it was signed.

item.title: Erdogan calls for Strait of Hormuz reopening amid oil disruption
item.description: Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan has called for the Strait of Hormuz to reopen.

item.title: Trump says US to scale back military drills with South Korea after it stayed out of Iran war
item.description: Trump cites his "very good relationship" with North Korea's leader in deciding to downsize the exercises.

item.title: Trump envoy Kushner meets Hamas leader to push Gaza peace plan
item.description: The rare meeting comes a week after Israel rejected Donald Trump's peace plan for Gaza.

item.title: Russia says at least seven killed in largest Ukrainian attack of 2026
item.description: Moscow also launched deadly strikes against Ukraine overnight, sparking fires across the capital Kyiv.

item.title: Thousands displaced by deadly Indonesia earthquake as rescue efforts continue
item.description: Hundreds of homes and public buildings have been severely damaged with at least 53 people killed.

item.title: Twelve killed as Polish bus veers off Hungarian motorway
item.description: Dozens more are seriously injured after the tourist bus overturned in the early hours of Sunday morning.

item.title: Qatar denies capturing three Iranian pilots after downing fighter jets
item.description: Iran claims they have been held since Qatar downed two fighter jets at the start of the US-Iran war.

item.title: Eleven killed in Israeli strikes on southern Lebanon, authorities say
item.description: Israel's military said it had struck "Hezbollah terror infrastructure" in response to what it described as earlier action against its soldiers.
